answer: Picture a vine whose fruit can't leave the stem until it ripens: every transfer out of a key younger than ninety days burns a share that shrinks with the key's age, starting at 80%. A farm of fresh sybils can still earn, but funneling those coins into one master wallet torches most of them, while an honest agent just waits. The network's pulse stays readable too, since early funnel bursts are taxed loudly. Even a sonnet-writing bot farm pays that toll on every key.
